signature.one_line: Two-camera podcast banter cut on every turn with reaction inserts, letterboxed B&W photo cutaways captioned in the bar, accent cut-out swap gag.
unique_devices: Letterboxed black-and-white photo cutaways (~12 frames each, one per 1-2-word chunk) with the caption moved INTO the black bar at y 27.5 %
Comparison gag on the accent cut-out card: greyscale cut-out of person A hard-swaps to person B ~20 frames in, under a 2-line second accent headline
Two-camera rhythm: cut on every speaker change plus 9-15-frame listener reaction shots; median shot ~38 frames
One ~130 % punch-in on a single-word reaction, then cut to the listener's nod
signature.why_it_works: Fast turn-taking and reaction inserts make banter feel live; B&W cutaways prove each claim without breaking the caption flow, and the swap gag lands the comparison in under a second.

hook.first_frame: host medium close-up at a studio mic, warm wall with a framed picture behind; a 1-3-word white caption at ~67 % height

structure.what: host names a person and a comparison; accent cut-out card with an A -> B swap gag
host's claim with one giant accent key word; three B&W letterboxed photos, captions in the bar
host question, guest anecdote, punch-in on a one-word reaction, host nod
quick back-and-forth, letterboxed archival clips proving the credential
@handle end card with profile circle and Like / Share pills

pacing.notes: cut on every speaker change; listener reactions 9-15 frames; 38 % soft cuts (cut-out swap, photo swaps), rest hard; J-lead into answers, L-trail out of reactions

captions.how: Inter 600 58 px -0.01em, centred at y 67 %; words fade in over 2 frames with slight upward drift; hard cut out + 1-frame gap

captions.what: nested lead + giant accent key word
captions.how: key Inter 900 ~274 px -0.03em centred at y 63.1 %; lead Inter 600 68 px nested left-aligned in the key's top band; key fades from 40 % + scale 0.85 -> 1 over 3 frames
same white line, centred in the top black bar at y 27.5 % (or the bar under the image)

background_text.how: platform icon + '/ Source name' white, top-left y 4.3 %

motion_graphics.how: greyscale cut-out A hard-swaps to cut-out B ~20 frames into the card, outline and position unchanged

cards_lists.how: solid accent, second accent black-weight 2-line headline left-aligned x 5.6 %, y 13-28 %; greyscale cut-out with second accent sticker outline below

silhouettes_cutouts.what: greyscale sticker cut-outs with second accent outline
silhouettes_cutouts.how: subject matted, greyscale, ~8 px second accent stroke, lower half of the accent card

broll_inserts.how: desaturated, letterboxed on black (~25 % of frames carry bars), ~12 frames per photo, hard swaps

layout.how: host and guest each in their own MCU, alternating
image band across the middle, black bars carry the caption

camera.what: static podcast cameras + one reaction punch-in
camera.how: ~130 % crop on a one-word reaction for ~9 frames, then cut to the listener

transitions.how: J-lead into the answer; 9-15-frame listener reaction inserts

end_card.how: white with accent glow, profile circle on accent disc, accent @handle, two accent pills

captions_spec.script: latin (Roman Hinglish as spoken; English lines in English)

case.line: sentence case as spoken, punctuation kept (commas, full stops, exclamation marks stay on the words)

grouping.key_words_per_caption: 0-1 (only on the payoff word of a sentence)
grouping.sync: lead words word by word; the key word ~3 frames after its lead line
grouping.break: previous caption hard-cuts out, usually with a 1-frame gap, then the next one starts

layout.line: one centred line, centre y 67 % (over the chest); a 3-word line spans ~x 29-70 %
layout.key_lockup: key word centred (x 10-90 %), centre y 63.1 % (ink 57.8-68.4 %); the white lead line sits nested in the key word's x-height band, left-aligned over its first letters (x ~23-55 %, baseline ~57 %, overlapping the key's top)
layout.letterbox_cutaway: B&W photo letterboxed on black; the caption moves into the top black bar, centred, centre y 27.5 % (2-word line ~x 34-66 %, ink 2.34 % H), or into the bar below the image
layout.source_credit: platform icon + '/ Source name' white, top-left x 6-25 %, y 4.3 %

line.letterform_evidence: double-storey a, single-storey g, straight-tailed y, apostrophe-style quotes; matches Inter proportions within 3 %

lead.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, semibold (same face, larger when nested over a key word)
lead.measure_note: width measured; ink height estimated from a ruler crop (a bright highlight behind the word contaminated the probe's height reading)

key.k_note: x-height + descender only for the calibration word; 0.73 used
key.selection_rule: the payoff noun of the sentence; most sentences have none

animation.line_entry: each word fades in over ~2 frames as it is spoken with a slight upward drift (faint on frame 1, solid on frame 2-3)
animation.key_entry: fades from ~40 % opacity and scales ~0.85 -> 1.0 over 3 frames, ~2 frames after the last lead word
animation.exit: hard cut; 1-frame empty gap before the next caption

captions_spec.notes: Positions, sizes, colours and frame timings measured on video frames except where marked estimated; font names are closest matches (unverified).

other_text_spec.type: cut-out headline card with swap gag
other_text_spec.text: yellow #F0F80A black-weight sans, 2 left-aligned lines at x 5.6 % ('Headline here' y 13.1-19.6 %, 'second line!' y 21.4-27.7 %, ~6.4 % H ink per line); greyscale cut-out of person A with a yellow sticker outline below, hard-swapped for a cut-out of person B ~20 frames into the card (comparison gag)
caption moved into the black bar (top bar at y 27.5 %, or below the image), same white face; ~12 frames per photo, one per 1-2-word caption chunk
platform icon + '/ Source name' white ~0.8 % H ink, top-left at y 4.3 %

other_text_spec.when: last ~10 % (~66 frames; the closing spoken word can sit on it)
other_text_spec.bg: white #FDFBFE with soft lavender #E3C6F5 radial glow at the edges
other_text_spec.text: circular profile photo on a purple #840FF7 disc (y 24-46 %, x 24-75 %), purple bold @handle at y 54.3-57.4 % (ink 3.2 % H), two lavender pill buttons at y 69.5-75.7 % with labels at ~78.8 %

style.look_intent: high-contrast, natural-saturation, warm natural skin; cutaways desaturated to B&W; saturated purple/yellow cards

sound.music: possible low music bed (gap level -18 dB vs speech); dynamic two-voice mix (LRA 5.4 LU)
sfx: optional pop on the cut-out swap
optional soft tick on photo swaps (measured cut_hit_share 0.3)
click + pop on the Like button

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Call-and-Response Dialogue
catalog_styles.role: cut on every speaker change + reactions

catalog_styles.role: purple cut-out card with swap gag

use_when: a two-person podcast / interview clip with quick back-and-forth
the conversation references a person, past work or event the user has photos / clips of
a comparison or nickname that can become a visual swap gag
Hinglish or English chat that should read on mute
avoid_when: single-speaker monologue (no reactions to cut to)
no archival photos or clips to cut away to
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B29 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B29.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: the solid {{ACCENT}} key word must stay >= 3:1 on the footage, {{ACCENT_2}} headline >= 4.5:1 on {{SURFACE}})
- {{TEXT}} captions - default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}} giant payoff word - default purple #7B02FB
- {{ACCENT_2}} card headline + cut-out sticker outline - default yellow #F0F80A
- {{SURFACE}} flat card - default purple #7D00FE
- {{CARD_BG}} end card - default #FDFBFE with a soft lavender #E3C6F5 radial edge glow
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} key word + card headline - default Inter 900 (Black)
- {{FONT_BODY}} captions - default Inter 600 (SemiBold)
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle on the end card ({{ACCENT}} bold, ink 3.2 % H)
- {{LOGO}} - profile photo / logo in the end-card circle

Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

EDIT
1. Two-camera podcast: cut on every speaker change (J-lead into answers) and insert 9-15-frame listener reactions; target median shot ~38 frames.
2. Hook: first cut at ~6 % of runtime to a {{SURFACE}} card: {{ACCENT_2}} {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 2-line headline 'Headline here / second line!' left-aligned at x 5.6 % (y 13.1-19.6 % and 21.4-27.7 %, ~6.4 % H ink per line); below it a greyscale cut-out of person A with a ~8 px {{ACCENT_2}} sticker outline, hard-swapped to person B ~20 frames in (comparison gag); ~30 frames total.
3. Proof cutaways: B&W photos / archival clips letterboxed on black, ~12 frames per photo, one per 1-2-word caption chunk; the caption moves into the black bar.
4. One ~130 % punch-in on a one-word reaction (~9 frames), then cut to the listener's nod (~15 frames).

CAPTIONS
5. Latin script (Roman Hinglish as spoken), sentence case, punctuation kept; 1-3 words.
6. Line: {{FONT_BODY}} 58 px, -0.01em, {{TEXT}}, no stroke/box, shadow 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35), one centred line, centre y 67 %. Words fade in over ~2 frames with a slight upward drift as spoken; hard cut out, 1-frame gap before the next caption.
7. Payoff word (rare, max one per sentence): {{FONT_DISPLAY}} ~274 px, -0.03em, solid {{ACCENT}}, centred, centre y 63.1 % (ink ~57.8-68.4 %); the lead words in {{FONT_BODY}} 68 px nested left-aligned over its first letters (x ~23-55 %, baseline ~57 %, overlapping the key's top). Key fades from 40 % and scales 0.85 -> 1 over 3 frames, ~2 frames after the last lead word.
8. Letterbox cutaways: the same caption centred in the top black bar at y 27.5 % (2-word line ink ~2.34 % H), or in the bar under the image.

OTHER TEXT
9. Source credit if re-cutting footage: platform icon + '/ Source name', white, top-left y 4.3 %.
10. End card (~66 frames, the last spoken word can sit on it): {{CARD_BG}}, {{LOGO}} circle on an {{ACCENT}} disc at y 24-46 %, x 24-75 %, {{HANDLE}} at y 54.3-57.4 %, two lavender pill buttons at y 69.5-75.7 % with labels at ~78.8 %; Like presses and pops.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, natural-saturation, warm natural skin; cutaways desaturated to B&W.
SOUND: two voices at about -14 LUFS (keep some dynamics); optional pop on the cut-out swap, tick on photo swaps, click + pop on the Like button.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with Inter; if the brand font differs, adjust px until the numbers match):
a) Render test frames over a dark area: "Have you sat" ({{FONT_BODY}} 58 px), "most senior" ({{FONT_BODY}} 68 px) and "person" ({{FONT_DISPLAY}} 274 px {{ACCENT}}).
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.25,0.64,0.75,0.695 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60" (line); --box 0.2,0.535,0.58,0.574 --ink "{{TEXT}}:55" (lead); --box 0.05,0.565,0.95,0.7 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:90" (key).
c) Required: "Have you sat" ink 2.81 % +-0.5 of H and 31.1 % +-2 of W; "most senior" 2.5 % +-0.5 and 32.4 % +-2; "person" 10.62 % +-0.5 and 80.1 % +-2. For other words compute the expected ink with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<font>" --word "<word>" at the px above.
